programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Price of Greed : An armed robbery is a terrifying ordeal. When a gang descended on a Los Angeles cash vault, they threatened to kill anyone who resisted. The violent assault was the largest heist in U.S. history and a piece of plastic was the only evidence.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Independence Day Breakout : In 1987 the New Mexico Penitentiary housed hundreds of violent offenders, rapists, killers, men the juries put behind bars to protect society. On July fourth, seven of those men escaped.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: A Model Killer : It's a model's job to rivet the public's attention. But in 1984, some aspiring models began attracting publicity in a terrible new way.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Shattered Shield : In a city awash in narcotics the drug lords have all the power even over the police. Corruption in New Orleans grew like cancer, eating away at public safety and threatening to destroy the city. Crooked cops break the laws they were sworn to uphold.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Hunter's Game : In the 1970's and 80s, people went to Alaska looking for a fresh start, to reinvent themselves, or to disappear for a while. Some of those disappearances weren't by choice.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Death of A Diplomat : In the 1970's South America faced a surge of political kidnappings and assassinations. When the killings spilled onto U.S. soil it was time for the FBI to step in.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Home Invaders : Too often, convicted felons learn new techniques and find new partners in prison. In 1982, a group of former inmates began a spree of kidnapping and robbery.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Under Fire : A series of armored car heists and bloody shoot-outs shocked law enforcement. The brutal violence of the crimes suggested a motive more complex than greed. When the robbers started targeting police, the FBI took charge.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Unlawful Flight : In Alabama, two desperate criminals fled the custody of a local deputy. Eluding authorities, they made their way across the country in a wave of car theft, abduction, and murder.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Death in Alaska : The day began like any other for Cheryl and Paul Chapman, until the silence of a peaceful Sunday morning was shattered with a phone call.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Bad Company : In Boston, FBI agents and local police tracked a gang of robbers who specialized in armored car takedowns. Their MO was familiar. The gang used precise timing to steal millions in cash and burned their getaway cars to destroy evidence.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Robin The Hood : In the southwest one serial bank robber claimed his loot went to the poor, but this thief was no folk hero. He had a gun and was willing to shoot.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Bitter End : In Las Vegas, a gang of robbers target an ATM repository and hit the jackpot. Their take was over a million dollars in cash, the largest heist in Las Vegas history.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: The Search For Lisa Rene : When a young woman was grabbed from her Texas home, the police raced to find her abductors. On the face of it, the kidnapping seemed like the random act of desperate men.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Deadly Threat : A suspected drug dealer would stop at nothing to keep local and federal authorities from building a case against him. When his organization started targeting the government itself, federal agencies went on high alert.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Sniper At Home : In Georgia, a series of bizarre shootings terrorized a small town. Two people were killed. Two others were critically wounded. At first, the shootings seemed targeted. Then they seemed random.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Death Grip : Fingerprinting: The identification Division of the FBI relies on fingerprints as one of the most effective ways to identify criminals.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Without A Trace : Missing Person: Approximately 1.8 million Americans are reported missing each year. Worldwide, the number of missing persons nearly triples.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Electronic Witness : George Orwell's concept of Big Brother remains in the realm of fiction. But as technology becomes more a part of our lives, it's becoming increasingly more difficult to make a move without leaving behind an electronic trace.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Grave Discoveries : Some cases simply can't be solved with current technology or with the evidence at hand. But that doesn't mean they'll remain unsolved forever.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Traces Of Guilt : Sometimes the scales of justice are balanced by just a few milligrams of evidence  a couple of fibers, a tooth filling, or a smudge on a piece of tape. The biggest cases are often solved by the smallest clues.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Deadly Chemistry : The show examines cases of poison and deadly chemistry and shows how forensic experts are solving mysterious deaths today and from the past.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Patterns Of Guilt : The tread of a tire, a single shoe print and even the shape of a bruise help investigators track down killers, based solely on their patterns of guilt.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Blind Trust : A woman's body is found and investigators have little time and few clues to lead them to a killer who could strike again. Perpetrators try to conceal their crimes, yet savvy investigators can take the most obscure data and recreate a murder.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Web of Clues : Forensic Entomology: Bugs have roamed the earth for 250 million years, but their intimate association with death is just now coming to life.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Fatal Error : Accidental deaths, suicides, disappearances, and fires; they're an everyday part of an insurance investigator's life. But cases shouldn't be taken at face value. Forensics has become a tool for exposing insurance fraud.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Lasting Impressions : No matter how chaotic or how clean a crime scene appears to be, the culprit is bound to leave something telling behind. Occasionally, it's nothing more than a fingerprint or shoe tread. Sometimes that's all that's needed.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Price of Murder : Using science as their most powerful weapon, investigators must find these hired killers and make them pay the true price of murder.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Critical Evidence : To the astute detective and forensic specialist, the biggest clues often hide in plain sight, and what seems trivial to some is in reality Critical Evidence.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Coroner's Casebook : A good coroner provides what's necessary to solve a crime. A bad one can spoil an otherwise rock-solid case. Cyril Wecht and Henry Lee, two of the country's most respected coroners, share their cases and insights into crime solving.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Fatal Compulsion : Forensic psychologists delve into the minds of serial killers, explaining why, most often, they can be a friendly neighbor or the tenacious co-worker  the one who hides his or her dark side better than anyone else.

programme.title: Wonder Pets

programme.title: Wonder Pets

programme.title: Wonder Pets

programme.title: Wonder Pets

programme.title: Wonder Pets

programme.title: Ni Hao, Kai-lan
programme.desc: Kai-lan Goes to China : Kai-lan gets a phone call from her favorite great aunt , Gu-nai-nai, in China, inviting us to come to China and meet a baby panda! Ye-Ye, Kai-lan, and her friends take an airplane to China to meet the baby.

programme.title: Ni Hao, Kai-lan
programme.desc: Ladybug Festival : Kai-lan and her friends are hiking through the woods to the big Ladybug Festival! Tolee gets frustrated when the others don't listen to what he has to say. Kai-lan needs your help to figure out what to do.

programme.title: Ni Hao, Kai-lan
programme.desc: The Dinosaur Balloon : Kai-lan, Rintoo and Stompy are making a special dinosaur-shaped balloon for Lulu's hot air balloon festival!

programme.title: Ni Hao, Kai-lan
programme.desc: Playtime at Tolee's : Everyone's going over to Tolee's boat house to play, and Kai-lan invites us, too! All the friends have a great time... until Rintoo accidentally rips Tolee's new panda painting.

programme.title: Ni Hao, Kai-lan
programme.desc: The Moon Festival : Hoho is thrilled because he's finally old enough to stay awake for the Chinese Moon Festival. He gets disappointed when he can't see the moon in the cloudy sky and Kai-lan needs your help to figure out what to do.

programme.title: Ni Hao, Kai-lan
programme.desc: Kai-lan's Big Play : Kai-lan and her friends are putting on a play based on the Chinese folktale about the Monkey King. When Rintoo gets the part that Hoho wanted, Hoho quits the play and it's up to the viewer to help Kai-lan figure out what to do.

programme.title: Ni Hao, Kai-lan
programme.desc: Kai-lan's Big Surprise : Today, Kai-lan needs our help to plan a very special party for Ye-Ye to thank him for all he does for us. But when everything she plans goes wrong, Kai-lan gets very frustrated and starts to cry - much to the surprise of her friends!

programme.title: Ni Hao, Kai-lan
programme.desc: Stompy Rides Again : Kai-lan and her friends are riding a TRAIN all the way to Hula Duck Island! Everyone loves riding the train through the backyard, but when it gets to Stompy's house, there are no seats left for their elephant friend on the train.

programme.title: Ni Hao, Kai-lan
programme.desc: Rintoo's Big Flip : Kai-lan and her friends go to see the Chinese Rabbit Acrobats and are invited to be in the show! Rintoo is sure he'll be able to flip without practicing - no problem! Kai-lan needs your help to convince Rintoo to practice.

programme.title: Ni Hao, Kai-lan
programme.desc: Rintoo Makes a Splash : Today, Ye-Ye is taking Kai-lan and our friends to a super special, magical water park! Everyone's having a blast – until Rintoo starts splashing, cannonballing, and playing much too rough.

programme.title: Ni Hao, Kai-lan
programme.desc: The Ants Dance : Kai-lan sees the ants dancing in Ant City, and is inspired to help them put on a big dance show for everyone to see! But when they start to get ready, a bossy ant named BuBu makes all the choices about the dance routine.

programme.title: Ni Hao, Kai-lan
programme.desc: Lulu's Cloud : Today, we're all invited over to Lulu's magical house in the clouds! Kai-lan is thrilled that Mr. Dragon is flying us there.

programme.title: Ni Hao, Kai-lan
programme.desc: Tolee's Turn : Kai-lan invites us to come sail a beautiful dinosaur boat with her friends – and play hide and seek with some dolphins! But when Rintoo won't give Tolee a turn steering the boat, things come to a standstill.

programme.title: Ni Hao, Kai-lan
programme.desc: Hula Duck Dance Party : Kai-lan invites us to a dance party at the Hula Ducks' island beach house! But when the party games lead to Tolee having to sit out each time, he starts to cry.

programme.title: Ni Hao, Kai-lan
programme.desc: Pandy's Puddle : Today, there's a special Garden Celebration, and Kai-lan and her friends are gathering their best vegetables. But when Tolee's beloved stuffed panda, Pandy, falls in the mud, Ye-Ye takes Pandy away for a cleaning.

programme.title: Ni Hao, Kai-lan
programme.desc: Kai-lan's Snow Coaster : It's a snowy day, and Kai-lan and her friends are building a snowcoaster that they can all ride! Everyone has a job to do, but Rintoo keeps taking little Hoho's jobs because he can do them so easily.

programme.title: Ni Hao, Kai-lan
programme.desc: Kai-lan's Playhouse : YeYe and the ants have built a beautiful playhouse for all the friends to play in! Everyone gets an area to decorate themselves, and lots of arts and crafts materials.

programme.title: South Park

programme.title: South Park

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Tweek contre Craig : Les garçons forcent leurs réticents camarades de classe, Tweek et Craig à se battre.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Les Jakovasaures : Cartman découvre un Jakovasaure femelle, puis un mâle.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: CM1 : C'est la rentrée. Les garçons arrivent en CM1, heureux de ne plus se faire taper par les grands du CM1. Mais ce sont désormais les CM2 qui les tapent. La nouvelle prof Mme Chrokelpaf, ainsi que la nouvelle façon de travailler les effrayent.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Le Super Classeur : Cartman vient d'acheter un tout nouveau classeur avec toutes les fonctionnalités. C'est alors qu'un homme venu du futur le prévient que ce classeur peut envahir la planète. Le classeur est donc détruit, mais Cartman s'en rachète un le lendemain.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Helen Keller! The Musical : Thanksgiving approche et comme tous les ans, les CM1 doivent jouer la vie d'Helene Keller. Butters s'est infiltré chez les maternelles et leur annonce que leur spectacle est superbe.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Camp de Régime : Cartman est envoyé en Camp de Régime car tous ses proches trouvent que c'est mauvais pour lui d'être gros. Il décide alors de tirer profit de cette expérience, mais pas de la manière dont ses proches le souhaiteraient.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Le Mot en M : Les enfants veulent aller voir un concert, mais les parents de Kyle refusent de le laisser y aller. Kyle décide alors de trouver un moyen pour se débarrasser d'eux. Cartman lui conseille d'appeler la police et de dire qu'il se fait maltraiter.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Le Cycle du Caca : Cette année, les garçons ont peur de ne pas avoir de cadeaux de Noël. Les gens n'achètent plus. Kyle décide alors d'aller voir Mr Hankey pour l'aider a redonner l'esprit de Noël.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Scott Tenorman doit mourir : Cartman voudrait être le premier de la bande à atteindre la puberté. Il achète donc des 'poils' 10 dollars à un garçon plus âgé, Scott Tenorman.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Y'en a Dans Le Ventilo : La série Cop Drama va diffuser un épisode ou le mot 'Merde' sera prononcé. Dès lors une épidémie de peste se déclare.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Combat d'Infirme : Al Super Gay est viré des scouts parce qu'il est gay. Et les enfants font la connaissance de Jimmy Valmer, un handicapé qui prend la vie avec humour. Mais Timmy est jaloux du succès de Jimmy, et un combat d'infirmes est engagé.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Terrance et Phillip : de tempêtes en naufrages : Terrence et Phillip, les canadiens pétomanes, mettent fin à leur duo pour divergences créatives. Les garçons se mettent en tête de réunir leurs idoles.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman Land : Suite à la mort de sa grand-mère, Cartman hérite d'un million de dollars et réalise son rêve de toujours: il achète un parc d'attraction (dont il profite tout seul) qu'il rebaptise 'Cartmanland '.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Du bon usage du preservatif : Les parents découvrent que leurs enfants sont très mal informés sur les choses du sexe. On demande à l'école de donner des cours. À croire que les parents ignorent qui sont les enseignants, Mme Crockelpaf, Mr Mackey et Mr Garrison.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Servietsky : À peine les enfants ont-ils obtenu leur console Gamesphère qu'on leur enlève. Ils doivent livrer une serviette intelligente fumant des pétards a une organisation militaire. Seulement les gamins se retrouvent embrouillés dans une histoire.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Oussama Ben Laden pue du cul : Kenny, Cartman, Stan et Kyle sont envoyés par erreur en Afghanistan. Sur place et contre toute attente, ils vont s'apercevoir qu'ils ont beaucoup de points communs avec les enfants Afghans.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Comment manger avec son cul : Cartman placarde la photo de Kenny associée à la mention 'Enfant disparu' sur tous les packs de lait du pays.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: L'Engin : Mr Garrison, ne supportant plus que ses vols d'avions soient annulés ou retardés, décide d'inventer un nouveau moyen de transport.Kyle est très embarrassé quand il reçoit la visite de son cousin de New-York, également prénommé Kyle.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Les riches debarquent : Se sentant rejeté, Token décide d'appeler d'autres riches. Mais les hommes de la ville ne supportent pas l'arrivée de ces riches.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Kenny Se Meurt : Cartman tente de sauver la vie de Kenny en suppliant le Congrès de faire reprendre la recherche sur les cellules souches.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: L'Episode de Butters : Butters fait quelques découvertes qui vont changer le cours de son existence. Son père est bisexuel et sa mère tente de le tuer. Heureusement tout s'arrange à la fin.

programme.desc: Dora's Got a Puppy : Abuela gives Dora and Boots a present for Dora's new puppy, but they'll have to watch out for Swiper, who's got a bunch of new swiping tricks up his sleeves.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Big Sister Dora : Dora has some really exciting news to tell us: Someone new is joining Dora's family! Someone who sleeps in a cradle, drinks from a bottle, wears diapers and likes to be rocked to sleep. Can you guess who it is? That's right!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Boots to the Rescue : Oh, no! Dora left her music homework in Boots' room. It's a song in English and Spanish, and she needs Boots to bring it to her school so she can sing it to the class.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Super Babies : Dora's baby brother and sister just love bananas, but they also love stories! So Dora tells them a Super Babies story! The Super Babies have to get their bananas back from that Super Villain Swiper the Fox.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: We're a Team : Dora and all her friends are at the Super Adventure Race! To win the race, they have to make it across the Troll's tricky Bridge, past the Volcano filled with gooey balls, over the giant wall, and all the way to the finish line.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: The Mixed-Up Seasons : It's summertime, and Dora and Boots are having a blast at the beach. But suddenly, they encounter the strangest sight - a snowman in Summer? What's wrong with this picture? Oh, no!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: The Shy Rainbow : Dora and Boots are hiking on Rainbow Rock when they come across a shy rainbow, Arco Iris, hiding behind a waterfall.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Baby Crab : Dora and Boots are having a blast at the beach when all of a sudden they hear a call for help. It's a baby crab stuck in a net!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Swiper the Explorer : Dora and Boots are playing catch when they discover a lost Baby Fox. And he wants his mommy! Just then, Swiper shows up to swipe Boots' superball.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora's Jack-in-the-Box : Dora's twin brother and sister have been sick and she wants to buy them a present to cheer them up. Way up on a toy store shelf, she finds a dusty Jack-in-the-Box.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Bark, Bark to Play Park : It's Twins Day and everyone's getting ready for the big Twins Day Party at Play Park! Dora even has a surprise for her puppy Perrito. He has a twin too -- a long-lost puppy brother he hasn't seen since they were babies.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora Saves Three Kings Day : "Happy Three Kings Day!" Dora, Boots, and Diego are dressed up as kings for the big Three Kings Day party. They'll be bringing a horse, a camel, and an elephant to carry the presents, and treats for the party, but Swiper scares the animals away!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Isa's Unicorn Flowers : Dora and Isa are planting Isa's special unicorn flowers when suddenly a baby unicorn, Unicornio, rides in on a Rainbow. He's thrilled to see Isa's beautiful flowers because they're his Mami's favorite.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora and Diego Save Atlantis : Dora and Diego Save Atlantis: Dora, Boots, and King Unicornio leave Enchanted Forest to join Diego in making the lost continent of Atlantis rise by ending an ancient feud between unicorns and dragons!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora and Diego Save Atlantis : Dora, Boots, and King Unicornio leave Enchanted Forest to join Diego in making the lost continent of Atlantis rise by ending an ancient feud between unicorns and dragons!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora's Knighthood Adventure! : Dora's Knighthood Adventure!: Dora and Boots are reading stories about knights with their friends Rocinante the horse and Dapple the donkey when suddenly they hear a cry for help.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora's Knighthood Adventure! : Dora and Boots are reading stories about knights when suddenly they hear a cry for help. It's a princess who's calling us from the Royal Garden! It turns out that it's not the princess that needs saving – her kitty's stuck in a tree!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Swiper's Favorite Things : Swiper was packing all of his favorite things for a sleepover at his Grandma's House. But just as he was about to go, a big wind came in and blew everything away! Will Swiper find a way to use his new super-Swiper-spin today?!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: A Ribbon for Pinto : When the train to the Big Horse Show breaks down, Dora, Boots, and Pinto the Pony need your help to get there with the ribbons, so Pinto can win his first blue prize ribbon!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Benny the Castaway : Dora and Boots are getting ready for a big beach picnic with their friends, but when Benny gets stranded on Coconut Island, he'll need rescuing from Dora, Boots, and YOU!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora's Fantastic Gymnastics Adventure : Dora gets to start the Big Gymnastics Show! But when Swiper swipes her special rainbow ribbon, Dora and Boots need your help on a gymnastics-filled adventure to get it back so they can begin the show! Fantastic gymnastics!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora's Moonlight Adventure : One night, while taking care of Abuela's 3 kitties, Dora awakens to find that Lucky has chased a ball of string right into a storybook world! Help her find him on a magical moonlight adventure!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Perrito's Big Surprise : Dora has a big surprise for Perrito on Surprise Hill, but Swiper's trying to get there first to swipe it! Join Dora, Boots, and Perrito for an animal-filled adventure with help from lots of friends and their playful pets too!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora's Thanksgiving Day Parade : Everyone's getting ready for the big Thanksgiving Day parade and dinner, but the Pirate Piggies accidentally float away on Dora's boat float.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Check Up Day : Dora's on her way to the doctors for her yearly check-up! Dora likes going to see Dr. Valdés because she gets to hear her heartbeat, see how much she's grown in one year, and get a new sticker at the end of the visit!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Little Map : Little Map: Map has been teaching his nephew, Little Map, how to draw pictures that help us on our adventures. And he's getting really good, so today he's ready for his very first treasure adventure!

programme.desc: Little Map : Map has been teaching his nephew, Little Map, how to draw pictures that help us on our adventures, and today he's ready for his first treasure adventure! We help Little Map draw pictures and play map games to find the treasure at Treasure Mountain!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Baby Bongo's Big Music Show : Dora and Boots take Baby Bongo on a musical adventure as they race to the Big Music Show in time for Baby Bongo's first performance.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: School Science Fair : Dora and Isa have been learning how the Earth's natural energy can power things we use every day. So they've made a volcano for the Science Fair!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora's Rescue in Mermaid Kingdom : Dora and Boots are at the beach when they find a little lost mermaid who needs to get back to her mommy at Mermaid Cove. Together the 3 set off on an underwater adventure!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: ¡Vamos a Pintar! : Dora and Boots discover Pincel, a cute little paintbrush who's lost and really wants to get back to Painter Daniella at the Art Studio.

programme.title: Arthur

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Arthur's New Puppy/Arthur Bounces Back : Arthur's new puppy is exactly what he wanted. He's cute and wriggly, and he follows Arthur everywhere. But training a puppy is harder than Arthur thought. Then, a mere $10 stands between Arthur and the shoes he's been dreaming about.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Arthur Babysits/Arthur's Cousin Catastrophe : You think running a marathon is hard? Try babysitting for the Terrible Tibble Twins. Next, Arthur's family is hosting the once-a-year-is-more-than-enough family reunion. But a major thunderstorm turns this into a reunion to remember.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Arthur's Birthday/Francine Frensky, Superstar : Only four more days until Arthur's birthday party! programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Arthur's Baby/D.W.'s Baby : Arthur is not too sure he's ready for a new baby in the house. What do babies do besides cry? Then, living with a baby is no picnic. Just how long will Baby Kate be hanging around, anyway? And who would even miss D.W. if she ran away?

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Arthur Writes A Story/Arthur's Lost Dog : Struggling with a school assignment, Arthur decides that his regular life is just too boring to write about. And, Arthur is the only one who believes in the superior intelligence of his dog. But even Arthur gets confused when Pal runs away.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: So Long, Spanky/Buster's New Friend : D.W.'s beloved bird gets very sick, and despite D.W.'s eager ministrations, Spanky dies. Can she risk giving her heart to another pet? Then, Buster doesn't have time for Arthur. And all he wants to talk about is a new friend named Mike.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Arthur The Wrecker/Arthur and The True Francine : Arthur always seems to wreck things, and this time it's Mom's computer. Can he get it fixed before Mom finds out? Then, Muffy A. Crosswire and Francine are absolute best friends, despite their rather obvious differences.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Arthur's Family Vacation/Grandpa Dave's Old Country Farm : What's got moldy bathrooms, lumpy beds and lots of rain? Arthur's family vacation. Then, Arthur and D.W. go to visit their grandfather, but the visit doesn't turn out as expected, because Grandpa Dave isn't your usual kind of grandfather.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Arthur and The Crunch Cereal Contest/D.W. Flips : A year's supply of Crunch Cereal is in store for the person who can write the new Crunch Cereal jingle, and Arthur is sure he can do it. Next, how hard can it be to do a cartwheel on a balance beam? D.W. is about to find out.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Meek For A Week/Arthur, World's Greatest Gleeper : Muffy bets Francine she can't be nice to everyone for a whole week--and soon wishes she hadn't. Next, Arthur didn't mean to tell a lie, he just got stuck in a sort of fib, because he thought it was cool to be a Gleeper.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Lost!/The Short, Quick Summer : One day, Arthur falls asleep on a bus and awakens in a strange part of town. Will he ever find his way home? Can he keep himself from crying? Next, summer vacation is over? What about all those great, fun things Arthur intended to do?

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: D.W. Goes To Washington/Arthur's Mystery Envelope : D.W.'s on her way to Washington and she's bored by it all until she gets lost during a tour of the White House. Then, when Mr. Haney gives Arthur a sealed envelope to bring home to Mom, Arthur fears the worst.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: D.W.'s Deer Friend/Buster Hits the Books : It’s time to celebrate summer! Join Arthur as he takes a family vacation and visits Grandpa Dave’s farm. Then, Arthur, D.W. and Buster spend a few days at the beach where they discover the simple joys of building sandcastles!

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Arthur's Faraway Friend/Arthur and The Square Dance : Arthur's in the midst of writing a great adventure story with Buster when he gets some very bad news--Buster is leaving town to go live with his Dad for a while. Then, does Francine have a crush on Arthur?

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Water and The Brain/Arthur The Unfunny : Is The Brain a snob? That seems to be the explanation for why he won't go to Waterworld with his friends. And, Arthur's a notorious joke-killer. But when he's scheduled to perform as a carnival clown, he learns how to make people laugh!

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Sue Ellen's Lost Diary/Arthur's Knee : Poor Sue Ellen has lost the one thing she's never without--her diary. Then, Arthur's hurt his knee but won't tell Mom--because then she'd know he'd been playing down at the dump , where he was NOT allowed to go.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Grandma Thora Appreciation Day/Fern's Slumber Party : Arthur and D.W. are planning a surprise party for Grandma Thora. But amidst the party-planning mayhem, they forget about the guest of honor! Then, shy Fern hosts a slumber party at her mother's urging.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Love Notes For Muffy/D.W. Blows The Whistle : When Muffy tries to bribe the judges at the school science fair, Francine and The Brain plot revenge. And D.W., a newly-deputized Junior Safety Officer, has a reputation for being a strict enforcer of the rules--well, OK, a tattle-tale.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Francine Redecorates/Arthur The Loser : Francine and Catherine are very different, but it’s no fun if you're two sisters sharing the same room. Then, there's only one thing in life Arthur really wants—to win! But he just can't stop losing. Is it really so wrong to cheat a little?

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Arthur vs. The Very Mean Crossing Guard/D.W.'s Very Bad Mood : Arthur and The Brain encounter a new crossing guard on the way home from school. This guard isn't just mean, he's nuts! And, D.W. is making Arthur's life miserable! Francine decides she'd fix D.W.'s behavior before Arthur loses his mind.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: D.W.'s Name Game/Finders Key-Pers : D.W. and Arthur get their feelings hurt when their efforts to insult each other get out of control. Next, Arthur, Brain, and Binky find a key--but to what? And which of them will get to keep whatever fabulous thing they find with it?

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: How The Cookie Crumbles/Sue Ellen's Littler Sister : What's a budding entrepreneur to do when her homemade cookies hit the big time? Especially when the recipe isn't really hers? Then, Arthur and Francine would love to lend their sisters to Sue Ellen, who's sick of being an only child.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Buster's Back/The Ballad Of Buster Baxter : Buster's coming home! The word spreads fast, but so does the fear that Buster will be different. Then, it seems to Buster, not only have his friends changed while he was gone, but they've forgotten all about him! Will he ever fit in again?

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: D.W., All Fired Up/I'd Rather Read It Myself : When Ms. Morgan announces they'll be having a fire drill during preschool, D.W. wants no part of it--it sounds way too scary. Then, the Tibble Twins are better than D.W. at just about everything.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Arthur Goes Crosswire/Sue Ellen And The Brainasaurous : Since they rescued Wilbur Rabbit, Arthur and Muffy have been inseparable. But the rest of their friends are growing tired of the new Arthur. And, Brain's a great partner for a school assignment--unless you wanted to work on it, too!

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Background Blues/And Now Let's Talk To Some Kids : Wouldn't it be cool to find out that your ancestors were famous frontier explorers? But what if they were just...plain folks? The Magic Toolbox show is coming to Ratburn's class to put the kids on TV!

programme.desc: The Chips Are Down/Revenge Of The Chip : What a mysterious, beautiful thing a green potato chip is--and D.W. just ate a gigantic one! But then she hears a rumor that they're poisonous...Sure, kids do some pretty embarrassing things, but do Moms have to tell everyone?

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: Canada : The two funniest and most brilliant chef/restaurateurs in Canada, Joe Beef's Dave McMillan and Fred Morin, take Tony across Canada by rail.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: Colombia : Tony will explore several regions of Colombia from the mountains down to the Caribbean coast to the coca leaf growing inlands formerly controlled by drug cartels.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: Congo : Bourdain looks at the Congo as one of the more industrialized powers in Africa now largely crumbled to nothingness and chaos with Tim Butcher author of Blood River.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: Copenhagen : Tony explores Copenhagen, the economic and cultural center of Denmark.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: Detroit : Detroit holds a unique place in American history. Few cities have seen such a dramatic rise and fall from economic boom to disparity. Tony explores the past, present and future of the Motor City.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: Hawaii : Tony explores the other Hawaii, the one that those eight million tourists don’t see when they come to the islands. He discovers the fabric of a true cultural mixing pot.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: Iran : Few countries have a more contentious relationship with the United States than Iran. In this episode we heads to this Shia Muslim nation to explore a country few Americans have visited since the 80s.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: Israel : Israel, the West Bank and Gaza are three locations Tony has never travelled to before.The intense and fraught relationship between these places is hard to understand but Tony will attempt to delve into the lives of those who live here, through their food.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: Punjab : Tony dives into the state of Punjab, India, starting off in Amritsar.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: Russia : Welcome to Putin’s Russia. If you don’t fall into line, you could be the target of a show trial and be thrown into a penal colony. But if you’re hungry you might actually find something worth eating.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: Salvador, Brazil : Tony heads back to his much-beloved Salvador, Brazil. The ever-present street festivals and the famous Carnival parade begin with sitting down with a local artist in the streets of the historic Pelo.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: Scotland : In this episode of Parts Unknown, we first visit the city of Glasgow, then we head north into the Scottish Highlands.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: Shanghai : Anthony Bourdain explores the vibrant, dynamic city of Shanghai.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: Shanghai : Tony travels to Shanghai. Forget the antiquated views you might hold about a communist-run, creativity-devoid State of androids. The modern China is a vibrant, dynamic monument to capitalism.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: Sicily : Sicily isn’t about fast food or the fast life. It’s about savoring family, life, food and making the most of what you have. Tony will go in search of those foods and their producers and eat his way around the island.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: South Africa : Once Johannesburg was the most dangerous city in the world, but the end of the apartheid has lead to vast changes in the city. Tony visits the Johannesburg suburb of Hillbrow, and discovers the culture and, of course food.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: South Korea : After eight years, Tony returns to South Korea. And this time, he’s no stranger to kimchi. But just as Tony has changed, so has Korea.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: Spain : Tony visits Andalucia during Semana Santa – Holy Week – a time filled with great pageantry and excitement. Tony’s longtime DP, Zach Zamboni, currently lives in Granada with his fiancée, Fuen Sanchez.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: Tangier : Tony explores what Burroughs called "Interzone," where artists sought escape from Western moral prohibitions and the possibilities of great empty spaces. But what is it like now?

programme.desc: Learning Curve : As part of an exchange program with the planet Orban, O'Neill travels to Earth with a girl who possesses incredible technical knowledge. But by the time O'Neill discovers the truth behind the child's superior mind…it may be too late for them all.

programme.title: Stargate Atlantis
programme.desc: Tabula Rasa : With Atlantis plagued by an amnesia-causing virus, McKay wakes up with no idea who he is or what is going on. Following instructions from a video he recorded earlier, McKay frees himself and sets out to find the key to unlocking this mystery.

programme.title: Stargate Atlantis
programme.desc: Missing : Arriving on New Athos for an overnight visit, Teyla and Dr. Keller discover the entire settlement abandoned and their own lives in jeopardy from the Bola Kai, a fierce warrior tribe. The pair must avoid capture until Atlantis sends a search party.

programme.title: Stargate Atlantis
programme.desc: The Seer : With still no trace of the Athosians, Teyla requests an off-world visit to meet with a seer, Davos, who may be able to help her find her people. Meanwhile on Atlantis, Agent Woolsey arrives to observe and review Col. Carter.

programme.title: Stargate Atlantis
programme.desc: Miller's Crossing : After working for countless hours on the Replicator coding, Dr. McKay reluctantly admits that he needs help from his sister, Jeanie. But she goes missing, McKay travels to Earth determined to find her and uncover who is behind the kidnapping.

programme.title: Stargate Atlantis
programme.desc: This Mortal Coil : As Dr. McKay struggles to figure out why the stargate has been inoperable, a mysterious probe plunges into the city. A sweep of the probe offers McKay a shocking glimpse of nanite code before his diagnostic program crashes and all the data is lost.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: Rules Of Engagement : SG-1 lands in the middle of a blazing battle between some Stargate soldiers and a Jaffa army. Believing the soldiers to be the missing-in-action SG-11 team, O'Neill and the others provide assistance… until the mystery team turns its weapons on SG-1!

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: Forever In A Day : During a rescue of captured Abydonians, Daniel finds his missing wife, Sha're. But instead of greeting him, she attacks him - leading to her death at the hands of Teal'c. Distraught over her death and angry at Teal'c, Daniel quits Stargate Command.

programme.title: Stargate Atlantis
programme.desc: Be All My Sins Remember'd : Armed with the means to track Replicator ships, the Atlantis team strives to eliminate the Replicators once and for all. Now, the team rushes to evacuate those human settlements in the path of the advancing Replicator forces.

programme.title: Stargate Atlantis
programme.desc: Spoils Of War : The Atlantis long-range sensors detect the signal of a subspace tracking device familiar to Dr. McKay. The team follows to signal to a damaged hive ship drifting in space. Amidst the ship’s records, they discover references to a secret Wraith base.

programme.title: Stargate Atlantis
programme.desc: Quarantine : When an alarm sounds, McKay suspects that a highly infectious disease has triggered the city’s self-protection system. With vital systems affected, the Atlantis team finds themselves trapped in various sections of the city with no way out.

programme.title: Stargate Atlantis
programme.desc: Harmony : Wanting to maintain diplomatic relations, Sheppard and McKay to accompany Harmony, a precocious young princess, on a mandatory rite of passage. However, they are unaware that she has enemies, and character flaws, yet to be dealt with.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: Point Of View : Alternate reality versions of Carter (Amanda Tapping) and Kawalsky (Jay Acovone) are found in Area 51. Brought to Stargate Command, they start to deteriorate. However, return to their own reality means death, as their world was invaded by Goa'uld!

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: Deadman Switch : SG-1 is captured by Aris Boch, a bounty hunter chasing an evil Goa'uld named Kel'tar. He offers them freedom in exchange for their help. They agree, only to find that Kel'tar is, in fact, a Tok'ra, whose capture would endanger countless others.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: Demons : On another one of their quests, SG-1 encounters a medieval civilization and frees a woman tied to a stake as a sacrifice to a demon. When the woman is freed, the demon vows to destroy the village unless the SG-1 team is offered up in appeasement.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey
programme.desc: Insubordination : Cagney (Sharon Gless) and Lacey (Tyne Daly) find themselves investigating a cocaine dealing case that suddenly becomes much more complicated when their commanding officer turns out to be Dory McKenna (guest star Barry Primus).

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey
programme.desc: Old Debts : Cagney (Sharon Gless) and Lacey (Tyne Daly) are on the protection duty of a recently paroled cop killer while he awaits a new identity and is moved away. After he is murdered while under their protection, Cagney and Lacey work to find the murderer.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey
programme.desc: Fathers & Daughters : When a man's suicide turns out to be a murder, Cagney and Lacey must figure out who the true murderer is after the man's wife and daughter both confess to the crime. The investigation only becomes more complicated when they discover more.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey
programme.desc: Taxi Cab Murders : When a string of violent murders takes place, Cagney and Lacey go undercover as Taxi Cab drivers to try and find the killer. Lacey's family becomes hysterical at the prospect, fearing that Lacey will lose her life in pursuit of justice.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey
programme.desc: Unusual Occurrence : When a young boy refuses to comply with her commands and Cagney (Sharon Gless) is forced to shoot him, her life becomes a nightmare. Cagney must deal with having shot a young boy, while the press claims it to be racially motivated.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey
programme.desc: Thank God It's Monday : Cagney (Sharon Gless) and Lacey (Tyne Daly) spend the weekend on duty going through old paperwork when they discover a warrant for a rape case that expires in 24 hours. The two must race to serve the warrant before it expires.
